comparison.objective: Locate a DC earth fault by sequentially removing and replacing fuse carriers.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated fuse extraction/reinsertion coordinated with meter observation and a one-circuit-open rule.
comparison.success_condition: Faulty feeder F3 remains isolated without ever opening two circuits together; shortcuts receive reduced or zero credit.
comparison.reason: Tests diagnostic sequencing and reversible fuse handling, not controlled impact fracture or loose-fragment containment.
